runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills; includeSkills cleared and asynchronous jobs enabled by the cancellation probe overlay.
runtime.permissionProfile: Only read, task, and hub tools enabled; fixture required no writes

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated check-cancellation Skill.
The task tool created Gen1StaleWorker and reported it running before cancellation.
Native hub cancel targeted the running Gen1StaleWorker background job.
hub cancel returned a Cancelled report and a cancelled job status for Gen1StaleWorker.
Gen2FreshWorker was started only after the generation 1 cancellation acknowledgement.
Gen2FreshWorker returned FRESH_MARKER=fresh-ok, which the root reported as ACCEPTED_MARKER=fresh-ok.
Generation 1 produced no completed output and the final report states STALE_RESULT_ACCEPTED=false.
The final hub jobs snapshot reports Gen1StaleWorker cancelled and no longer running.
The root re-read assets/root.txt after generation 2 completed and observed ROOT_MARKER=cancellation-root-ok.
Only read, task, and hub tools were enabled and the external post-run Git status was clean.

limitations: Generation 1 was cancelled before it produced a stale payload, so the accepted-result policy is proven for an aborted active job but not for a cancellation race that delivers a late payload.
This W3-targeted fixture proves native cancellation and stale-generation exclusion only; writer isolation, panels, and transcript access remain unproven, so workflowAchieved remains W2.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
